Method of Attack: Steals cryptocurrencies by manipulating the system clipboard to substitute wallet addresses with those belonging to the attacker

Logs keystrokes, accesses the host's clipboard, conducts disk scans to uncover credentials and other valuable data, transmits information to C2 server via various communication channels (HTTP(S), SMTP, FTP, Telegram)
Collects sensitive data, establishes communications with C2 server, downloads additional files from the server to execute keylogging or password recovery functions
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Word documents containing embedded URLs leading to malware download
Malicious Word document that triggers the execution of a multi-stage loader, which in turn downloads and executes various payloads (RedLine Clipper, Agent Tesla, OriginBotnet)
